candidateAudit.text: . . . This city is pure elegance, filled with stunning architecture and rich history everywhere you turn. You can feel the classical music vibes everywhere, and there are coffee houses showing up all over the place. I also love watching the Viennese people too; they seem to be having a blast with their families and friends, catching opera shows, dining out, and definitely rocking their personal style in a way that totally fits the city’s vibe. I’ve come across some ladies in their 80s who totally know how to own their style, almost like they’ve stepped out of a different era. They even put on bright red lipstick just to hit the grocery store, and honestly, that’s pretty inspiring. . . . . . . . #vienna #wien #austria #travel #style

candidateAudit.text: 🇦🇹 European Eateries: Figlmüller, Vienna A Vienna classic, with a gluten-free twist. 🤍 We visited the original Figlmüller location to experience the restaurant famous for its iconic, oversized Wiener Schnitzel. While my crew tried the legendary schnitzel, I enjoyed a gluten-free chicken dish with lingonberry jam and hash browns. candidateAudit.text: 🍿 Tee, der nach Popcorn schmeckt? Oh ja! Genmaicha ist grüner Tee mit geröstetem Reis. Beim Rösten poppen manche Körner auf, daher sein Spitzname Popcorn-Tee. Er schmeckt frisch und grün wie Sencha, dazu getoastet, nussig und ein bisschen herzhaft. Die Geschichte dahinter ist wunderschön: Grüntee war in Japan lange teuer, also streckte man die kostbaren Blätter mit geröstetem Reis. So wurde Genmaicha zum Alltagstee der einfachen Leute, mit weniger Koffein als reiner Grüntee und einem Aroma, das satt und zufrieden macht. Heute ist er ein Klassiker, der für seinen warmen, getreidigen Charakter geliebt wird. In unserem Latte trifft er auf cremige Hafermilch, ganz ohne Süße. Röstig, rund und genau richtig für alle, die es gemütlich mögen, aber nicht zuckrig. Hol dir deinen Latte jetzt an unserer Elixir Bar, sie ist Mittwoch bis Samstag für dich geöffnet. -> Neubaugasse 58, 1070 Wien 🍵 Pur oder als Latte, wie trinkst du deinen Tee am liebsten? #dancingshivavienna #elixirbar #genmaichalatte #pflanzenkraftwerk #viennaeats

candidateAudit.title: 🇦🇹 Vienna is known for its café culture, and rightfully so - from its grand, traditional coffeehouses to its modern cafés and brunch spots. ☕️ I was pleasantly surprised by OPal
candidateAudit.text: 🇦🇹 Vienna is known for its café culture, and rightfully so - from its grand, traditional coffeehouses to its modern cafés and brunch spots. ☕️ I was pleasantly surprised by OPal Eat & Drink and their selection of French galettes (buckwheat crêpes). I’ve always loved galettes and have tried them in France and Poland, so finding them in Vienna was such a delightful surprise! Knowing full well that I probably wouldn’t finish two, I couldn’t resist ordering two flavours: 🍄 Champignon - Mushrooms, Gouda cheese and sour cream, topped with a fried egg. Comforting, savoury and delicious, but a more classic combination. 🍎 Normande - Camembert, apples, thyme, walnuts and honey, also topped with a fried egg. And the Normande? Absolutely mind-blowing. The interplay of sweet and savoury was out of this world. The sweetness from the apples and honey wasn’t overwhelming; instead, it perfectly balanced the richness of the Camembert, the earthiness of the walnuts and the aromatic thyme. Every bite made me want another. It’s the kind of unexpected flavour combination that stays with you long after the meal - the sort of dish you find yourself reminiscing about. I couldn’t finish both in the end, so I packed the rest to take away. No food wasted! 😂 They offer plenty of other brunch options, but their extensive selection of galettes is undoubtedly the highlight. The spacious, comfortable interior also makes it a lovely place to slow down and enjoy a relaxed brunch. A definite recommendation if you’re exploring Vienna’s modern café scene. And if you go, get the Normande! 📍 OPal Eat & Drink, Vienna #ViennaFood #ViennaEats #ViennaBrunch #Galette #ViennaFoodie

Tipp: Kreuzkümmel kurz ohne Fett in der Pfanne rösten und dann mahlen – das macht den Geschmack. candidateAudit.title: Mango Lassis and the Problem of Induction 🥭 As an Austrian who’s in love with Indian food, I understand the urge to pair every Indian takeaway with a mango lassi. But let me tell
candidateAudit.text: Mango Lassis and the Problem of Induction 🥭 As an Austrian who’s in love with Indian food, I understand the urge to pair every Indian takeaway with a mango lassi. But let me tell you something that might shock you: mango lassi isn’t the only type of lassi. It’s just the only one that consistently shows up on menus around here. But don’t be fooled. Just because you’ve seen white swans all your life doesn’t mean black ones don’t exist. And just because the sun has risen every day for the past 4.5 billion years doesn’t guarantee it’ll rise tomorrow. If you’re up for spotting some black swans, I recommend zummoghulhof.wien. They serve some decent salty and spicy lassis, as well as a rose lassi. If, on the other hand, you fear the day the sun might never rise again, I recommend austriantaj1080 - home to the creamiest, sweetest mango lassi in Vienna. #IndianFoodVienna #ViennaFood #Lassi #IndianFood #FoodInVienna
